title: Commanders
hook: Choose who **leads the next lawn run**. The choice persists; a match snapshot freezes the leader when the board starts — you do not mid-wave swap the story.

blindSpots.meaning: Who leads the next lawn — open with `K`. Dave is the default face until you have more names.
When the match starts, the leader is frozen for that run.
Commander pick and aptitude spend exist in thin form; auras and fuller fantasy still catch up.
Different system — element colour of the army. Not the same as commander.

alsoTrue: Aura presence from that leader is [commander auras](commander-auras) (WIP).
Aptitude spend at commander scope reaches the side — see [aptitudes](aptitudes).

sections.title: How you use it
steps: Set the leader for the next lawn.
Start the match — the snapshot locks that leader for the run.

sections.title: What you do not do
paras: You do not mid-wave swap the story.
You do not treat commander as a class pick — free-build aptitudes still rule.

doSteps: Confirm who is set as default lawn commander.
Play a lawn match without trying to change leader mid-board.

mixUps.a: Default face until you have other commander names to put there.

mixUps.q: Why is this WIP if K opens?
mixUps.a: Thin pick/spend can ship while auras and depth stay WIP.
